transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us started on the activation plan review for the opening-night ceremony livestream. As we head into the pre-launch sign-off, I'll be going through the plan against the sponsorship contracts, broadcast traffic, and audience-data compliance before we lock the rundown and any public-facing materials. Since Brightline Mobile is the presenting sponsor, I want to make sure we're all aligned on the current draft — the stage backdrop logo, the ten-minute commercial break, the audience email collection for sponsor follow-up, and the host's sponsor thank-you during the award presentation. Are there any concerns or updates from anyone before I begin the formal review?

The current draft activation plan places the logo on the stage backdrop, which would violate the amendment. I also haven't entered the amendment into the sponsorship deal memo yet, so the deal memo doesn't reflect this restriction. We'll need to update the plan to move the logo to a lower-third graphic and get the deal memo updated accordingly.
